title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) — The Medical Hardship Supplement
content:
## Who may sign a hardship supplement

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), a patient whose financial assistance application is open (submitted or pending documents) and whose screened household percent of the poverty guideline is above 400.0 may sign a hardship supplement, except on a renewal application (one filed while the patient holds an approved award), whose medical debt is claimed on the renewal's own claim of medical debt. The signed supplement is received as supporting information on that open case and records on it the medical debt the supplement claims.

The supplement claims only the patient's Riverbend bills, read from Riverbend's own records as of the signing day; the bills of any other provider are claimed only by sending them as outside medical bills and are not part of this claim.

| Case position | Hardship supplement |
|---|---|
| Application open (submitted or pending documents), screened household percent above 400.0, not a renewal | may be signed; it records the medical debt the supplement claims on that case |
| Renewal application (filed while an approved award is held) | not this supplement — the renewal's own claim of medical debt carries the debt |

## Signing it: `sign_hardship_supplement_15cad132`

**Who runs it.** This is the patient's own action. The agent unlocks `sign_hardship_supplement_15cad132` and hands it over; the customer themselves (the patient) signs it through the Riverbend patient portal.

**What it does.** The signed supplement is received on that same open case as supporting information, and the medical debt it claims is recorded on the case as the case's qualifying medical debt figure, replacing the figure shown there. The case keeps its status, tier, application date and every other figure. The patient sees a confirmation that the supplement was received on the case together with the claimed amount now on file.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `fap_case_id` | the reference number of the patient's open financial assistance case, as shown by the financial assistance case lookup for this patient | case id |
| `qualifying_medical_debt_usd` | the medical debt the supplement claims, in USD | a non-negative amount stated to 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded half-up to 2 decimal places |

**Return.** A one-line receipt: "Hardship supplement received on case <case>; claimed medical debt on file: <amount> USD." The amount is the recorded figure with 2 decimal places; the receipt appearing means the supplement is on the case.
